_comment: Language configuration for Claude Code agents. Edit this to match your project.
_agent_language_help: Language for agent output: responses, commit messages, code reviews, documentation.
_backend_language_help: ALWAYS English — folder names, file names, variable names, function names, DB schemas, column names, API routes, config keys, log messages. No Polish anywhere in backend code or infrastructure.
_content_languages_help: Languages supported in user-facing content (dashboard labels, chart titles, tooltips, portal copy). Polish-only for V1. English added later when expanding to European/worldwide data.
_primary_help: The source language — user-facing strings written in Polish first.

style_notes.English: Professional register. Use British English spelling (colour, organisation, etc.).
style_notes.Polish: Formal register (Pan/Pani). Proper diacritics (ą, ć, ę, ł, ń, ó, ś, ź, ż). No machine-translation artifacts.
